title: Physical AC1018 WIPEOUTVARIABLES writer bridge
scope: A hash-bound ODA-produced AC1018 direct-NOD WIPEOUTVARIABLES witness is checked with the existing inline-object body/handle proof. Its typed record seeds a locally authored AC1018 wrapper DWG, which is re-imported and written to ASCII and Binary DXF with atomic refusal, retry, and typed rooted readback. The physical source is not converted as a whole, and its source class's common-link evidence remains unknown; the selected wrapper reconstructs only the witnessed direct owner/reactor profile.

physicalWitness.provenance: Scratch DXF authored from scratch with ezdxf and converted by ODA File Converter 27.1.0 to ACAD2004 DWG. LibreDWG 0.14 independently reports class 513, the ACAD_WIPEOUT_VARS entry, owner/reactor handles and frame 0.
physicalWitness.commonEvidence: The physical source frame's generic common-link evidence remains Unknown. The witness-specific callback probe confirms the typed owner, reactor, XDictionary-missing flag and raw handle roles for this exact source only.
physicalWitness.sourceLimitations: The source has 16+ other NOD entries and a 739-byte unclaimed HEADER suffix; whole-source output is refused.

wrapper.kind: locally authored AC1018 DWG generated in the focused selector
wrapper.fieldSource: The selected typed record seeds the wrapper. Its owner and reactor are emitted against the wrapper's NOD using the witnessed soft-pointer roles; no generic source common-link evidence is promoted.
checks: wrong owner/reactor and invalid display-mode refusal
wrapper.fixturePolicy: The wrapper DWG and output DXFs are temporary locally authored controls and are removed. The hash-bound physical source remains read-only; no drawing fixture was committed.

validation.result: passed; physical source proof, wrapper re-import, ASCII/Binary output, refusal/retry and typed readback

nonClaims: No whole-source physical conversion qualification follows.

No native AutoCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or independent wipeout display/plot acceptance was run.

remaining: Physical whole-source output with complete HEADER, object, and graph closure.
